answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 37996 Country: Pakistan Title: Nikah - No witness but video recording as a proof Question: The Nikah was done without any witnesses, but there is a proof in the form of video recording of bride and bridegroom making proposal and acceptance. Is it valid or not according to Sharia'a? Answer ID: 37996 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 631/542/B=1433) As ijab-o-qubool (proper exchange of proposal and acceptance of nikah from both sides) is necessary for nikah to place, in the same way it must be done in the presence of two Muslim witnesses. Nikah without witnesses is null and void. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
